title: Record legacy stock in and out in movement ledger
description: Close the audited inventory traceability gap by wiring the existing Purchase StockIn and Sales StockOut posting/reversal paths into the already-existing StockMovement ledger. Reuse current inventory services and tables; do not add or alter production schema.
acceptance_criteria: Approved StockIn posts a matching StockMovement using the same base-unit quantity and existing movement conventions.
Approved StockOut posts a matching StockMovement using the same base-unit quantity and existing movement conventions.
Unaudit/cancel paths reverse the corresponding movement without double-posting.
Existing inventory balances remain consistent with movement quantities and repeated operations are idempotently guarded.
Unit/integration tests cover stock-in, stock-out, reversal and duplicate protection; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Post stock-in and inspect movement trace.
Post stock-out and reverse it, verifying movement consistency.

human_gate.reason: Uses existing inventory tables/services only; no production schema or deployment action.
